description: This file defines an Angular service 'ApiService' that provides methods for interacting with a backend API related to events, user profiles, and authentication. It includes functions for CRUD operations on events, RSVP management, user profile updates, and authentication workflows.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: An Angular service class that encapsulates HTTP calls to a backend API for event and user management.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Fetches all events, optionally filtered by provided parameters.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Fetches a single event by its ID.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event with provided data.

methods.name: editEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event identified by ID with given changes.

methods.name: rsvpToEvent
methods.description: Adds an RSVP status ('going', 'interested', 'not_going') for a specific event.

methods.name: getMyRSVPs
methods.description: Retrieves RSVPs made by the current user.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event by its ID.

methods.name: getMyEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events organized by the current user.

methods.name: getMyProfile
methods.description: Fetches the profile information of the current user.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the current user profile with provided data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with email and password, returns a token and user data.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with name, email, and password.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user by removing the stored JWT token.

ctags.name: API_BASE
ctags.pattern: /^const API_BASE = '\/api'; \/\/ could be replaced by process.env.API_URL in real env$/

ctags.name: httpParams
ctags.pattern: /^    const httpParams = new HttpParams({ fromObject: params || {} });$/
